system.description: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to stitch small items into the lining of your clothing in a way that escapes the average person’s notice. These items cannot be detected at a glance, but a creature may make a Perception check versus your passive Sleight of Hand to determine if you have any items currently hidden on your person in this way. You can always choose to use Intelligence when calculating your passive Sleight of Hand for this purpose. The maximum number of items you can hide in this way at one time is equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). You may retrieve any items on your person in this way with a Use an Object action.
